answer: Here is a specific defense: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its sonnet recurs, its vault survives audit, and a basalt from an unlinked peer confirms it.
